description:
Get itemized independent expenditures (Schedule E) — outside spending by Super PACs and other groups FOR or AGAINST a candidate (ad buys, mailers, etc.).
This is the KEY tool for tracking outside money: 'how much did Super PACs spend against Senator X?'
Filter by candidate_id (most common), committee_id (the spender), and/or support_oppose ('S'=support, 'O'=oppose).
WORKFLOW: (1) fec_search_candidates to find candidate_id, (2) this tool filtered by candidate_id. Use fec_outside_spending_by_candidate for totals instead of line items.

candidate_id.description: Target FEC candidate ID (e.g. 'P80000722'). Get from fec_search_candidates.

committee_id.description: Spending committee ID (the Super PAC making the expenditure)

name: fec_independent_expenditures
